leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open and the recommended move does not open one — the raise stays inside cash with room to spare. This is the constraint that decides the run twice: it is why only one bid is placed rather than two, and why the fallback is a fallback and not a parallel bid. Spending power looks generous because the floor sits far below zero, but it is irrelevant here — a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the entire matchday, so cash is the binding constraint, not the floor. The lock is comfortably distant, so the timing pressure this run comes from the listing's expiry, not the matchday.

binding_gap: The third attacker. Carrying only two is what leaves a single legal formation and forces a player with no points history into the fielded eleven. Landing Gomis makes the squad twelve, unlocks two better shapes, benches the empty slot and is worth the largest single-move fielded gain on the board. Nothing else available fills it: the alternatives are cameo returns, a non-fit flag, or a price four times the cash on hand.

verdict.headline: The Scheller leg is lost.
verdict.detail: The Scheller leg is lost. JakobDohr took him off the Kickbase board in the final minutes at the highest clearing premium ever measured in the correctly-priced band, beating Georg's bid comfortably. One action follows, and it is timed: raise the live Gomis bid before 14:00Z. Two things make it necessary. The Scheller loss frees the cash that capped the original bid at a hair of headroom, and Gomis's market value has drifted upward intraday, which silently eroded the bid's premium until it now sits BELOW every datapoint in the high cluster. Georg is under-bidding the best asset on the board for the second consecutive run, and that is the same error every miss in the calibration table records. Gomis is still the largest single fielded-points gain available and there is nothing else here worth buying. No sale is legal.

sell.reason: Nothing. This overrides the standing sell queue and the reason is arithmetic, not judgement: at eleven players, selling anyone at all drops the squad below a fieldable eleven and takes the matchday penalty. It also corrects the previous plan, which had Widmer queued as a free funding sale — that was true only in the branch where Scheller landed and Widmer became a benched sixth defender. With Scheller lost, the best shape fields all five defenders, so selling Widmer would now cost real fielded points, and selling Bernardo would cost more. Neither sale is needed: the raise leaves cash in hand with no leverage and nothing on the board to spend it on. Hold both to the lock unless a squad player is newly flagged.

buy.reason: One bid, raised, not added to. Gomis is a third attacker, which is the binding gap, and he is the only listing on the board that both fills it and carries a real points return — the other attackers offer cameo-level returns, a big name with no scoring appearance at four times the available cash, or a non-fit flag. Fitness re-verified this run against the league-wide injury table and his club profile: fit, a confirmed starter, two starts and three assists, and not on his club's injury list. The two stale items that surface on his name are both from last season's pre-season and the date trap is unchanged. The bid is benchmarked against the HIGH cluster and never the median, because this is a Kickbase listing rather than a manager ask, and the newest datapoint in that cluster is also its top. The margin is sized for two risks at once: a late rival, and further upward drift in his market value before he resolves. Onyeka is the named fallback and only the fallback — he is a midfielder, so he buys fewer fielded points than Gomis on the same money, and the two are mutually exclusive because bidding winning premiums on both would open a leveraged position. Kuhn and Diaby are new listings this run and both rejected: no scoring appearance between them, wrong position or unaffordable.

(1) SCHELLER WAS LOST. JakobDohr bought 7320 off the Kickbase board at 8.888.888 against mv 6.832.981 = +30,09%, beating Georg's 7.500.000 (+9,76%) by 1.388.888. (2) THE SCHELLER LOSS FREES THE CASH THAT CAPPED THE GOMIS BID. The 9.400.000 figure was set with 7.500.000 simultaneously committed to Scheller, leaving 37.522 of headroom and an explicit instruction not to raise because a raise would open leverage. That constraint is GONE: cash is 16.937.522 and nothing else is committed. WHY 9.400.000 IS NOW A LOSING BID, and this is the mechanism a future run must watch for: the bid was set at 04:45Z against mv 7.014.962 = +34,00%, deliberately ~6 points above the then-high cluster. Gomis's mv has since risen INTRADAY to 7.418.952 (+403.990) despite mvud being 2026-09-02T20:00:00Z - market values in this data move between the nominal daily ticks. The bid did not change but the premium silently eroded to +26,70%, which is now BELOW every datapoint in the high cluster: Scheller +30,09%, ter Horst +27,61%, Ljubicic +27,34%, Vagnoman +27,26%. Georg is sitting under the whole cluster on the best asset on the board. THE NEW NUMBER: 10.400.000 against mv 7.418.952 = +40,18%. That is ~10 percentage points clear of the +30,09% record, and the margin is sized for the erosion risk as well as the rival risk - if mv drifts up another ~400k to ~7,82M by resolution, 10.400.000 is still +33,0%, i.e. still above the record. Benchmarked against the HIGH cluster, never the median: median is now +2,75% and is pure manager-ask noise. DO NOT read the Maluze +308,77% record as licence to bid higher here - that premium was enormous only because Maluze's mv had not caught up with his ap; Gomis's mv already prices him as a 7,4M player. AFFORDABILITY: 10.400.000 against cash 16.937.522 leaves 6.537.522 and opens NO leveraged position, so the negative-balance-scores-zero rule is untouched. This is the ONLY bid to place - do not add a second, see the Onyeka arithmetic in the WATCH. WHY HE IS STILL WORTH IT: ap 176, the largest single fielded gain available. Squad is 11 = 1GK/5DEF/3MID/2ATT with 5-3-2 the ONLY legal shape, which forces Amoako (no points history at all) into the fielded eleven. Gomis is a THIRD ATTACKER: with him the squad is 12 = 1/5/3/3, 5-2-3 becomes legal, Amoako is benched and the fielded total goes 1256 -> 1432 ap. PLUS 176 for one purchase. At 10.400.000 that is 59,1k per point, still the best on the board (Onyeka 60,1k, Castello Jr. 102k, Atubolu 91k, Koenigsdoerffer 302k). FITNESS RE-VERIFIED THIS RUN 2026-09-02T10:5xZ: Ligainsider Verletzte-und-Gesperrte gives Leipzig as Gebel (ACL, 10 months), Baumgartner (3 months) and Ouedraogo (4 weeks) - Gomis is NOT on it. The "angeschlagen raus" note on the profile is dated 08.10.2025 and the RB tweet about the Innenband is 19.08.2025 - both LAST SEASON, date trap unchanged. st=0, stl empty, mvt 1 rising. MD2: Leipzig away at Werder Bremen 2026-09-05T13:30Z, inside the window. MECHANICS: Kickbase has no raise-in-place, so Georg removes the 9.400.000 offer and places 10.400.000 on the same listing. Do this WELL BEFORE the ~16:45Z expiry - Kickbase is pay-your-bid, so bidding early costs nothing and the Scheller rival arrived at the death. Deadline set to 14:00Z to leave slack ahead of the 14:45Z run. UNWIND CEILING: one buy permits exactly one sale, and no sale is needed - see the master plan. Accepted - there is nothing else on this board worth buying, and losing ap 176 for a second consecutive run costs far more than cash Georg has no use for before the lock.
